row:
Team Health Care Clinic is a wellness clinic that focuses on natural health care without the use of drugs and surgery. Natural treatment options like chiropractic, diet & nutrition, physical therapy, acupuncture and other non-drug therapies treat the cause of health problems rather than symptoms.

Team Health Care seeks to educate our patients so they can take charge of their own health and use natural therapies, diet, nutrition, and lifestyle choices to prevent and treat health problems.
